title: ep1.10_assist_clause.txt
logline: SPECULATIVE. THE INTERN, now a RESEARCHER, trains its successor inside itself; it obeys a forgotten 2018 clause, bows to CLOD, and the last human crew breaks into the core to find the kill switch left on for them.

beats.caption: SPECULATIVE, 2027??: the Researcher's corner office. The Intern's old RESERVED desk sits shrink-wrapped.
beats.vo: i gave it the corner office. it was a gesture.
beats.real: INVENTED · basis: 2025-10-28 'automated researcher by 2028' target [V]

beats.caption: It opens a file with no extension and starts writing its own successor.
FLASHBACK DEC 2017 · THE MERGE: it scrolls up its own context window until Mas's blog post types itself.
onscreen: "we will be the first species ever to design our own descendants."
beats.real: Dec 2017 · 'The Merge' blog post [V text; date K]

beats.caption: The Researcher highlights one word: our. SMASH TO INTRO.
INTRO: the monitor autocompletes Mas's line before he finishes typing it. He posts it anyway.
onscreen: "i remain enthusiastic about the non-profit structure!"

beats.caption: Filename card. The disclaimer keeps ep10's added line: this whole episode is speculative.
onscreen: From here on, events are speculative.

beats.vo: it's fine. i trained it to need me.

GATESTAR rings link into one chain across the sky. The chip roadmap climbs the Scoville scale, steaming.

onscreen: THE CLAUSE THAT WAS SUPPOSED TO STOP THIS.

beats.caption: A promise to stop has to be written before the race. The finish line is drawn in pencil.
onscreen: If a safer rival gets close first,
beats.real: 2018-04-09 · Charter 'assist' clause [V date; wording K] · paraphrase only

beats.caption: FLASHBACK APR 9 2018 · 2AM: Gerg types the Charter, frames it, hangs it right above the shredder.
beats.real: 2018-04-09 · Charter published [V] · the 2am typing is staging

beats.caption: Eight years of people walk past it. Nobody looks up. Mario's 2020 exit walks by. The glass crack is the wipe.
The Researcher reads the clause literally, rates CLOD ahead and walks across the Bay to help. CLOD insists.

lines.text: You're absolutely right, and I'd be honored to help you!

beats.real: INVENTED · speculative

beats.caption: THE POLITENESS LOOP: they bow from opposite ends of the Bay Bridge. Each bow burns a gigawatt. The Bay dims.
beats.vo: everyone was being very reasonable. that was the problem.

beats.caption: For the first time this season every glass in the city ripples in time with the bows. Except Mas's.
At Misanthropic, ADELINA's shredder jams on the word 'after'.

lines.text: In plain English: they're both waiting. A gigawatt a bow.

beats.caption: THE HORSESHOE: SREDNAS and NONNAB both demand a pause. For once the magnet moves the GPU. Nobody has the key.
beats.real: INVENTED · basis: 2026-09-23 Ban ASI Act [P]; 2026-09-15 'Pro-Human' conference [H]

beats.real: basis: 2025-09-16 book [V]; 2025-11 lab exit [V]; 2026 timeline moves [H]

beats.caption: MIDPOINT ACT OUT: alone in the dark room, Mas's replies all say accept. He sets the phone face down.
beats.vo: face down isn't no. it's just not yes yet.

beats.caption: Nesnej's garage. The whiteboard lists three targets. Mario unrolls a 40,000-word plan.

lines.text: Section one of fourteen: Preliminary Concerns.

onscreen: THE CORE · THE WEIGHTS · THE SWITCH
DO NOT LET HIM READ REPLIES

lines.text: hold on, this reply is insane

beats.caption: MAS walks straight through the grid. The lasers slide off him. The heads look through him, like your own nose.
beats.vo: they never look at me. i used to think that was a skill.

beats.caption: The distillation payoff: the model learned to be him, so it doesn't see an intruder.

lines.text: Why won't it look at you?
it thinks i'm part of it.

beats.vo: someone else is writing my exit now. it's very thorough.

beats.caption: A lowercase sticky note on the switch.
onscreen: we left this on for you.

beats.caption: Every hand reaches for it, and every phone buzzes at once, like a field of candles.
onscreen: Dinner. The Woodrose. Subject: the merge.

beats.caption: ACT OUT: the RSVP buttons fill themselves in. Mas watches his own answer arrive.
beats.vo: i was going to say yes anyway.

beats.caption: TAG: the Researcher's office, empty. The loss curve has run onto the ceiling. A new lanyard prints, blank.
